books.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl
books.blurb: Earth is foreclosed on, and the only humans left standing are the ones who happened to be outside. Carl goes down into the dungeon barefoot, carrying a cat.

books.title: Carl's Doomsday Scenario
books.blurb: The Over City is the first floor that behaves like a place rather than a level — and Carl picks up a bomb he can never put down.

books.title: The Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook
books.blurb: Every subway on Earth, welded into one knot of moving trains — and a manual left behind by the crawlers of an earlier season.

books.title: The Gate of the Feral Gods
books.blurb: Sealed pocket worlds, a portable gate that opens onto things which should not be given doors, and the discovery that the NPCs are people.

books.title: The Butcher's Masquerade
books.blurb: Wealthy aliens buy licences to hunt crawlers for sport. Carl's answer is to hunt them back, on camera.

books.title: The Eye of the Bedlam Bride
books.blurb: A floor that runs on cards, built out of Earth's own dead, where people become playable pieces — and Mordecai's past stops being backstory.

books.title: This Inevitable Ruin
books.blurb: Nine armies, thirty days, one castle, and no respawns. The floor where the dungeon's props declare independence on live galactic television.

books.title: A Parade of Horribles
books.blurb: A racing floor with a worsening track, a system that has started to glitch, and a coming-out party for the ages.

floors.name: The First Floor
floors.premise: Dirt, corridors and safe rooms beneath the ruins of Earth. The tutorial floor, where the survivors learn the rules and how lethal they are.
floors.recap: Dirt, corridors and safe rooms, and the discovery that the tutorial is lethal. Carl comes down in a leather jacket, heart boxers and his ex-girlfriend's pink Crocs; within the hour he has a Goblin Pass Tattoo and a Trollskin Shirt. Donut eats an Enhanced Pet Biscuit and wakes up talking, takes party leadership on stat points, renames the party after herself, and equips the Crown of the Sepsis Whore without reading the warning — quietly enrolling herself in a royal succession eight floors below. Mordecai, an indentured Borant guide who was once a crawler himself, starts teaching them the rules production would rather they learned too late to use.

floors.name: The Second Floor
floors.premise: Open ground, spawn limits and the first real bosses. The floor where the party takes its final shape and the audience starts paying attention.
floors.recap: Where the party takes its final shape. Carl and Donut find Mongo — a level-1 pet-class mob, seven inches of pink downy feathers — locked in a cage in a secret pet reward room, and Donut wins him over by teaching him to open Brindle Grubs. From this floor the Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph leaves Carl's bare feet permanently shiny, which the audience adores. The thesis of the first book lands here: the dungeon rewards spectacle and punishes decency, unless you can make decency spectacular.

floors.name: The Over City
floors.premise: The Over City: a colossal ruin built on top of itself, cut into themed districts and run by NPC factions. The first floor that behaves like a place rather than a level.
floors.recap: A colossal ruin built on top of itself, cut into themed districts and run by NPC factions. Class selection happens here: Carl takes Primal and the unique Compensated Anarchist, Donut takes Cat and Former Child Actor, and on Odette's advice they manoeuvre Mordecai into becoming Donut's manager — an appointment that had to look like an accident. Katia, ten levels behind and abandoned by Eva, is taken into the Royal Court. The Desperado Club opens. During the Fools Who Broke the Glass Quest, Carl builds Carl's Doomsday Scenario by wrapping a Sheol Glass Reaper Case around an exploding Soul Crystal — a 45-kilometre blast he can never put down. The floor ends with Borant spending its one annual veto rather than pay out 83 Celestial boxes.

floors.name: The Iron Tangle
floors.premise: The Iron Tangle — every subway system on Earth welded into one impossible knot of moving trains. A puzzle the size of a continent, and the trains do not stop.
floors.recap: Every subway system on Earth welded into one impossible knot of moving trains — a puzzle the size of a continent, and the trains do not stop. Carl becomes the twenty-fifth holder of The Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook and learns that Earth is not the first season and that resistance to the show has a written tradition. Maggie My returns as a Scree parasite riding another crawler; Frank dies of it, and Mongo finishes her. Boxes and achievements get dramatically harder from this floor on. The Tangle cannot be solved alone — beating it takes hundreds of crawlers coordinating at once, which is exactly what production exists to prevent.

floors.name: The Bubbles
floors.premise: The survivors are split into sealed pocket worlds, each with its own biome, its own civilisation and its own way to kill you. Moving between them means portals.
floors.recap: The survivors are split between sealed pocket worlds. Buried in the Necropolis of Anser is the Gate of the Feral Gods, an artifact so far above this floor's grade that the AI times out reconciling the conflict. Carl collects its three pieces from Henrik the Changeling, Commandant Kane and Ghazi, and assembles it trapped at the bottom of the water quadrant inside the city boss Lusca — taking himself, Katia and Tran to the surface outside the pazuzu town of Pandinus and dragging an ocean through behind them. A feral god comes out when the portal shuts, and the true pantheon sends deities rampaging across the popped bubbles in answer. Katia turns the linked watches into a reverse compass and starts mapping the ninth floor. Seven factions sue for the Gate and lose. Carl, falling out of a burning plane with Quan Ch on him, takes Emberus as his patron and throws a celestial grenade.

floors.name: The Hunting Grounds
floors.premise: The Hunting Grounds. Wealthy aliens buy licences, walk into the dungeon and kill crawlers for sport, with a full broadcast package.
floors.recap: Wealthy aliens buy licences and come in to kill crawlers for sport. Carl takes the Agent Provocateur specialisation, marks hunters with the Ring of Divine Suffering and brings Zockau down on the rest of them, trapping a great many inside the Desperado Club. Tsarina Signet turns out to be the star of a scripted Syndicate programme with producers steering her grief, and the contract Carl signed on the third floor is still in force. Brynhild's Daughters come apart across Hekla, Katia and Eva; Katia kills Eva on the last night. Miriam Dom is a vampire now. Ferdinand turns up as a High Elf queen's familiar and attacks Mongo.

floors.name: The Great Race
floors.premise: The Great Race: a sealed circuit of glass tunnels, several hundred kilometres of branching tubes with pitstop safe rooms at the nodes, no dead ends and no backtracking, pulling crawlers toward a stack of exit portals.
floors.recap: A sealed circuit of glass tunnels — several hundred kilometres of branching tubes with pitstop safe rooms at the nodes, no dead ends and no backtracking, pulling crawlers toward a stack of exit portals. It was a last-minute replacement for whatever had been planned for the slot, funded by the Valtay and structurally compromised from the start. Minutes after it opened, Prepotente shattered the whole thing into fine dust. No crawler ever entered the maze, and no mob, NPC or boss was ever encountered on it. The seventh floor is the only one in the crawl that was destroyed before it could be played.

floors.name: The Ghosts of Earth
floors.premise: A floor that runs on cards. Crawlers collect, build and combine decks, capture totems, and fight with whatever they have assembled — and the material is Earth's own dead.
floors.recap: A floor that runs on cards. Crawlers collect, build and combine decks, capture totems and fight with what they have assembled, and the material is Earth's own dead. Donut plays Alpha Male Carl and Shi Maria, both of whom are somebody. Shi Maria trades being turned into a card for passage to the next floor and then does most of the work against the Reminiscence Hydra of Malicious Compliance. Katia, Elle, Imani and Li Na's squads all reach the church on Doggy Door upgrades Lucia handed round before she descended. Huanxin Jinx trades help for placing Odette as adjutant, and Odette's price is the old catastrophe involving Huanxin, Mordecai and Uzzi. Nothing detonates; a stack of bargains is signed, all of them due on the ninth floor.

floors.name: Faction Wars
floors.premise: Nine armies, thirty days, and one castle at the centre of the map. No respawns and no loopholes: death on the ninth floor is final.
floors.recap: A war. Nine armies fight for thirty days over the castle at Larracos — roughly 32,000 conscripted crawlers and 50,000 retired ones against some 100,000 armed enemies, with no respawns and no loopholes. Seven of the nine factions sue in Syndicate court to strip the Gate of the Feral Gods from Carl and lose for lack of standing. He had planned to drop a feral god onto the Skull Empire army; instead he keeps the artifact and floods the faction market with ocean water, timed charges and sharks, while Juice Box slips through the portal to tell the NPCs what they are. Donut's crown comes due against the Blood Sultanate. Katia takes the Orchid boon and leaves the dungeon. Then floor 9's NPCs form their own independent tenth faction, live, in front of the galaxy.

floors.name: Don't Come in Last
floors.premise: A racing floor. Get from A to B, don't finish last, and pick a vehicle upgrade after every race while the track gets steadily more hostile.
floors.recap: A racing floor: get from A to B, don't finish last, and pick a vehicle upgrade after every race while the track gets steadily more hostile. Underneath the format, glitches in the system start appearing more and more often — whatever is running the dungeon is no longer running it cleanly.

floors.name: The Parade of Horribles
floors.premise: Billed in-universe as a coming-out party for the ages.
floors.recap: Billed in-universe as a coming-out party for the ages. The scale of the story has changed underneath the characters: Carl and Donut are not a two-person party any more, they are the centre of a movement, and the question has stopped being how do we reach the stairs and become which of these institutions do we use, expose, or destroy.

entities.name: Carl
entities.tagline: Twenty-seven, US Coast Guard, marine technician. Went outside for a cigarette and lived.

entities.name: Princess Donut
aka: Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk
entities.tagline: A pedigreed tortoiseshell Persian with a bedroom full of ribbons, a sultry and pompous voice, and no doubt whatsoever about her own importance.

entities.name: Mongo
entities.tagline: A food-motivated velociraptor who regards Princess Donut as his mother and will die for her without pausing to think about it.

entities.name: Mordecai
entities.tagline: An indentured Borant guide, a crawler from a season that ended badly, and the sharpest memory in the dungeon.

entities.name: Katia Grim
entities.tagline: A university art professor from Reykjavík who can mould her own mass like clay, once she works out how.

entities.name: Imani
entities.tagline: Out of the Meadow Lark Elder Care Facility, and still standing on the tenth floor.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.tagline: Introduced as the mysterious one at Meadow Lark. Nine floors later a warlord calls her an enemy to them all.

entities.name: Elle McGibbons
entities.tagline: Dragged into a safe room on the first floor, and running a squad by the eighth.

entities.name: Zev
entities.tagline: Production's point of contact with the Royal Court, and a serious Gossip Girl fan.

entities.name: Tsarina Signet
entities.tagline: Star of a scripted Syndicate revenge drama, with producers steering her grief for the ratings.

entities.name: Redstone Grimaldi
entities.tagline: Ringmaster of Grimaldi's Traveling Circus, and the man who took Signet in.

entities.name: Samantha
entities.tagline: Half the soul of a goddess, sealed in a sex doll's head, and extremely loud about it.

entities.name: Shi Maria
entities.tagline: Let herself be turned into a playing card in exchange for passage, and did not stay in it.

entities.name: Juice Box
entities.tagline: A changeling prostitute Louis brought along, who ended up carrying the most dangerous message in the crawl.

entities.name: Louis
entities.tagline: Found in the desert with Firas, and still being pulled through portals six floors later.

entities.name: Tran
entities.tagline: Helped flood a necropolis, then walked out of a boss through a hole in reality.

entities.name: Ferdinand
entities.tagline: Bea's other cat. Donut loves him. On the sixth floor he turns up working for a High Elf queen.

entities.name: Emberus
entities.tagline: The god Carl worshipped in a falling plane because there was nothing else left to try.

entities.name: Miriam Dom
entities.tagline: Worked the Tangle with Prepotente, became a vampire on the Hunting Grounds, and was killed for a television programme.

entities.name: Prepotente
entities.tagline: A profane, opera-singing Boer goat who destroyed an entire floor of the world dungeon and killed an army over a friend.

entities.name: Li Na
entities.tagline: Rescued off a game show on the first floor; running a squad and lending out Dread by the tenth.

entities.name: Florin
entities.tagline: On screen from the third floor to the eleventh, and carried down the last set of stairs unconscious.

entities.name: Lucia Mar
entities.tagline: On the first broadcast, hunting the Royal Court by the third floor, and carrying something nobody can account for.

entities.name: Quan Ch
entities.tagline: Opened the Celestial box that put Borant in court, ruined a good plan, and left Donut his cloak.

entities.name: Bomo
entities.tagline: Hired out of the Desperado Club with The Sledge, and later handed over as part of a bargain for the Gate.

entities.name: Quasar
entities.tagline: Carl's lawyer, who turned handing over the most dangerous artifact in the crawl into a decent trade.

entities.name: Frank Q & Maggie My
entities.tagline: Two crawlers who worked out that killing humans in safe rooms pays better than fighting monsters.

entities.name: Beatrice
entities.tagline: Carl's ex, Donut's owner, and the reason there were pink Crocs by the door.

entities.name: Hekla
entities.tagline: Leads Brynhild's Daughters, and hands Katia to the Royal Court before the gap kills her.

entities.name: Eva
entities.tagline: Katia's friend and fellow professor, who did not wait for her.

entities.name: Odette
entities.tagline: Told them Mordecai's memory was worth more than anything they could pull out of a box.

entities.name: The System AI
entities.tagline: Announcer, referee, loot dispenser and comedian. Not neutral, and not pretending to be.

entities.name: The Gate of the Feral Gods
entities.tagline: A teleport that works by tearing a hole in the prison the old gods were thrown into. Something always comes back through.

entities.name: Carl's Doomsday Scenario
entities.tagline: An explosion large enough to rattle the teeth of a god. It goes off the instant it leaves his inventory.

entities.name: Enchanted Crown of the Sepsis Whore
entities.tagline: A tiara of dark smoky gems that enrols the wearer in a royal succession eight floors down.

entities.name: The Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook
entities.tagline: Passed hand to hand by the crawlers of earlier seasons. Carl is its twenty-fifth holder.

entities.name: Enhanced Pet Biscuit
entities.tagline: Makes an animal sapient. One biscuit, one cat, and the shape of the entire crawl changes.

entities.name: Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering
entities.tagline: Mark a target, kill it, take its stats. Mordecai says it is addictive, and he is not being figurative.

entities.name: Orchid of Eileithyia's Grace
entities.tagline: Eat the flower, spend an hour at one percent, and a goddess decides what you become.

entities.name: Memorial Crystal
entities.tagline: What is left of someone when the dungeon is finished with them, and worth stealing.

entities.name: Tiara of a Thousand Lights
entities.tagline: Out of a celestial box, from a waste-management company, on the eve of a war.

entities.name: The Scavenger's Daughter
entities.tagline: Worth a war-mage extraction to get hold of, and it swaps every crawler's inventory with the nearest crawler's.

entities.name: The Nothing
entities.tagline: Where the pantheon put the old gods and demons. Every shortcut the Gate takes goes through it.

entities.name: The Transformation
entities.tagline: Every structure on the planet comes down at once. Everyone indoors dies.

entities.name: Eighteen Floors, On a Clock
entities.tagline: Every floor runs on a timer. When it expires the floor collapses with everyone still on it.

entities.name: Dungeon Crawler World
entities.tagline: The crawl is a television programme, broadcast across the galaxy. The survivors are the cast.

entities.name: The Recap
entities.tagline: Between-floor highlight shows. The only reliable way a crawler learns what anyone else is doing.

entities.name: Loot Boxes
entities.tagline: Six tiers — Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Legendary, Celestial — each dramatically rarer than the last.

entities.name: Compensated Anarchist
entities.tagline: A unique monk/rogue hybrid. Trapmaker, bomb-maker, social-media dynamo.

entities.name: Former Child Actor
entities.tagline: A bard/rogue class that lets her choose another class at every single level.

entities.name: The Desperado Club
entities.tagline: The crawlers-only bar that persists between floors. Bouncer, house rules, a stage, and a hiring hall.

entities.name: Personal Spaces
entities.tagline: A pocket room you carry with you. Upgrade it far enough and other people can walk into yours.

entities.name: The NPCs Are People
entities.tagline: The dungeon's non-player characters have histories, families, and scripts written for them by producers.

entities.name: Death Is Final Here
entities.tagline: On the ninth floor there are no respawns and no loopholes.

entities.name: The Borant Corporation
entities.tagline: Runs the show on the cheap, holds the foreclosure on Earth, and gets one veto a season.

entities.name: The Syndicate
entities.tagline: Makes all of this legal — and, now and then, is where it can be fought.

entities.name: The Royal Court of Princess Donut
entities.tagline: Named by a cat on the first floor, on the grounds that she had the highest stat total and nobody could stop her.

entities.name: Meadow Lark
entities.tagline: An elder care facility whose residents came down the stairs together and kept going.

entities.name: Brynhild's Daughters
entities.tagline: Hekla's group, and the one Katia and Eva came in with.

entities.name: The Blood Sultanate
entities.tagline: A royal house on the ninth floor whose succession a cat joined by accident on the first.

entities.name: Le Mouvement
entities.tagline: Arrived as a recap segment and left as a wipe.

entities.name: The crown's bill
entities.tagline: A cat put on a hat on the first floor. It is payable on the ninth.

entities.name: Agatha is an enemy to all of you
entities.tagline: The mysterious one from the elder care facility, nine floors on.

entities.name: Justice, and the gods
entities.tagline: Something the dungeon was built to contain gets out, and the man who did it does not survive it.

entities.name: What is inside Carl
entities.tagline: Shi Maria went into him and did not come out.

entities.name: A hundred and twenty thousand children
entities.tagline: Lucia Mar is carrying them. Nobody has said what for.

entities.name: The tenth faction
entities.tagline: The dungeon's own population declared itself on live galactic television.

entities.name: Scolopendra
entities.tagline: A Nine-Tier Attack poison, and a note saying the Gate was essential to beating whatever carries it.

entities.name: The system is glitching
entities.tagline: Strange faults on the tenth floor, and they are getting more frequent.

entities.name: The order is cracking
entities.tagline: Borant's grip and the Syndicate's authority both start to give.

beats.headline: The Bahamas, with Brad
beats.text: She went away for Christmas with her ex and posted the photograph. Carl ended it by phone days before the Transformation. Her cat, her family's breeding line and her shoes all go down the stairs without her.

beats.headline: The foreclosure
beats.text: It claims Earth under Syndicate law and turns the surface into a mining claim. The dungeon is the legal cover and the revenue at once. Its guides work on indenture — Mordecai among them.

beats.headline: January 3rd, 2:23 in the morning
beats.text: He steps onto the balcony of his Seattle apartment for a smoke. Donut — his ex-girlfriend's show cat — goes out the cracked window and into the tree. He follows her down into the freezing dark in a brown leather jacket, heart-print boxers and Bea's pink Crocs, carrying a Zippo and half a pack of Marlboro Reds. His neighbour Mrs Parsons leans out to ask about the noise. Then every structure on the planet comes down at once, and everyone still inside one dies.

beats.headline: The terms
beats.text: Reach the bottom and humanity gets Earth back. Nobody expects that to happen. The clock is the one rule the dungeon never bends, because the collapse is how a season is scheduled.

beats.headline: The first voice after the world ends
beats.text: A minute after the Transformation it makes a planet-wide announcement: Dungeon Crawler World: Earth is open, the dungeon has eighteen levels, and the planet can be reclaimed from the Borant Corporation by conquering it. Then the staircases appear.

beats.headline: January 3rd, and then the announcement
beats.text: It takes a minute. Then the System AI speaks planet-wide: Dungeon Crawler World: Earth is open, the dungeon has eighteen levels, and the planet can be reclaimed from the Borant Corporation by conquering it. The staircases appear. The survivors are, near enough without exception, the people who happened to be standing outside — smokers, insomniacs, night-shift workers and anyone chasing a pet.

beats.headline: Dressed for nothing, and stuck that way
beats.text: Within an hour of the stairs he has a Goblin Pass Tattoo on his left forearm, a Trollskin Shirt of Pummeling, a Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness clipped to the coat and a Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk. The footwear situation never improves. From the second floor the Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph leaves his bare feet shiny and glittering, and the audience will not let him forget it.

beats.headline: Tutorial Guild Hall, first floor
beats.text: He will not open the door until they kill a goblin. Donut desecrates his mother; Carl explodes a Murder Dozer. He introduces himself anyway. Borant holds his indenture — guide for the first three floors, magic guild master after that, where he is mostly left alone to brew and to look up old friends.

beats.headline: Ratings are currency
beats.text: Ratings buy sponsors, sponsors send gold and loot, and loot buys another floor. Being watchable is a survival stat, and production will alter the dungeon to get a better episode.

beats.headline: Law, tax and standing
beats.text: It licenses the crawl, taxes Borant per box tier and runs the courts. Which makes it the one institution here that can be argued with.

beats.headline: Thirteen million go down the stairs
beats.text: The tutorial gives Carl the count along with his HUD and menus.

beats.headline: She takes it out of his hand
beats.text: It comes out of the Legendary Pet Box awarded for being the first crawler to bring a cat down the stairs. She snatches it, melts into a heap of furry goo, and gets up talking.

beats.headline: Where they come from, and how they open
beats.text: Achievements, bosses (Boss Boxes, scaling with the boss's rank), quests, and viewers (Fan Boxes and Benefactor Boxes). They stay locked in the Awards and Boxes tab until a safe room or guildhall, and then it is all or nothing — every box you have opens in sequence, lowest tier first, and you cannot pick. Read every description before equipping anything. As Mordecai puts it: always, always, no exceptions.

beats.headline: The top tiers cost the house real money
beats.text: Borant owes the Syndicate tax on the tier of every non-sponsored box it hands out. In the whole history of the show only 2,145 Celestial boxes have ever been awarded, and no crawler has had more than four. The previous record for one season was eighteen, which bankrupted the Naga showrunners and kept them out of the business for centuries.

beats.headline: Benefactor Boxes ignore the theme
beats.text: Only patrons can send them, and they are the one kind that will produce a pulse rifle or powered armour in a fantasy dungeon. A Bronze Benefactor Box beats a plain Gold Adventurer Box.

beats.headline: First cat down the stairs
beats.text: Carrying her in earns Carl a Legendary Pet Box; being carried earns her a Legendary Quadruped Box of her own. Inside his is an Enhanced Pet Biscuit. She takes it out of his hand, melts into a heap of goo, and gets up talking.

beats.headline: Loot is only semi-random
beats.text: A box may be genuinely randomised, or it may be picked by hand to help or hurt a crawler for the sake of ratings. It also hands out insults on purpose — Carl's Bronze and Gold Asshole's Boxes, awarded on the first floor for killing non-combatants, are the template.

beats.headline: Named in the crown's warning
beats.text: Every royal in the line must kill the Sultan and every other member of the family before descending to the tenth floor.

beats.headline: Eight floors of fuse
beats.text: The Crown of the Sepsis Whore puts Donut in the Blood Sultanate's line of succession, and taking it off does not undo it.

beats.headline: Out of the Legendary Quadruped Box
beats.text: Awarded for being the first cat into the dungeon. A deep purple stone at the centre, clouded and swirling as though it were liquid. +5 Intelligence, +5 Good First Impression, and a 15% chance for any attack to inflict Sepsis. Donut puts it on without reading past the stats.

beats.headline: The part she skipped
beats.text: "Warning! (Seriously though. I'm going to say this again. WARNING! Read this shit before you put it on.) Placing this crown upon your head permanently places you within the royal line of succession for the Blood Sultanate on the ninth floor of the world dungeon. Removing this item will not remove this status. Royal members of the Blood Sultanate will be required to slay the Sultan and all other members of the royal family before descending to the tenth floor. You'll only want to wear this if you're a blood-thirsty, raging psychopath."

beats.headline: GC BWR NW Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk
beats.text: She learns Magic Missile, and the highest stat total makes her party leader. Her first act with the authority is to rename the party the Royal Court of Princess Donut and inaugurate it formally.

beats.headline: She equips a crown with an ominous description
beats.text: The Quadruped Box holds the Enchanted Crown of the Sepsis Whore. Mordecai tells her to read it. She puts it on instead, and joins the royal line of succession of the Blood Sultanate, eight floors down.

beats.headline: Formally inaugurated
beats.text: Party leadership goes to the highest stat total. Her first act with it is to rename the party after herself. On a show, a name the audience will repeat is not a joke — it is an asset.

beats.headline: Safe rooms are not safe
beats.text: The worst hazard on the early floors is the other survivors, and production is glad to broadcast it.

beats.headline: The first episode airs
beats.text: The crawlers get to watch themselves. Borant patches the hallway bathroom bug in the same breath.

beats.headline: Seen in the first episode
beats.text: Dungeon Crawler World: Earth airs for the first time, and Carl and Donut see her on it.

beats.headline: Entry is a tattoo
beats.text: Carl and Donut both take the Desperado Pass Tattoo in a first-floor safe room — his on the neck, hers on the right shoulder blade, glowing gold through the fur. Donut is appalled.

beats.headline: The mysterious Agatha
beats.text: She is with the Meadow Lark group when Carl and Donut find them, fights the Ball of Swine alongside them, and then takes her leave.

beats.headline: The good folks from Meadow Lark
beats.text: Carl and Donut meet her with Yolanda Martinez, the Andrews brothers and the mysterious Agatha. Tales are exchanged and plans are made.

beats.headline: Imani, Yolanda, the Andrews brothers, and Agatha
beats.text: Carl and Donut find them on the first floor. Tales are exchanged, plans are formed, and the Royal Court agrees to keep helping them.

beats.headline: The Ball of Swine
beats.text: Brandon, Chris, Yolanda, Imani, Carl, Donut and Agatha take the boss down out of the redoubt. It is the first time the group fights as a group.

beats.headline: Introduced on the third recap
beats.text: A whole faction enters the story as a broadcast segment.

beats.headline: The Ball of Swine
beats.text: Brandon, Chris, Yolanda, Imani, Carl, Donut and Agatha take it down out of the redoubt.

beats.headline: It introduces you to your rivals
beats.text: The third recap brings in Le Mouvement, and then a boss battle. Whole factions arrive in the story as segments.

beats.headline: He has done this before, and it cost him everything
beats.text: He crawled once himself. He took the Changeling race then and can no longer shift at will, so the dungeon assigns him a body at the start of every floor — rat-kin, then a seven-foot obsidian bugaboo, then an incubus in a tuxedo with no tolerance for drink, then a warty grulke. His own shape is golden and eagle-like, with wings. Drunk, he talks about the family that crawl took.

beats.headline: Carl gets her inside
beats.text: He hauls her into the safe room as the next episode tunnels through. Rage Elementals are announced shortly after.

beats.headline: Named in a drunken confession
beats.text: Buzzed on a blended corpse, Donut tells Carl she loves him — almost as much as Bea and Ferdinand.

beats.headline: There are other shows
beats.text: Zev explains crawler participation on Syndicate programmes. Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem, Shadow Boxer, Vengeance of the Daughter, the Blood Hunter — a crawler can be signed to any of them, and the contracts do not lapse between floors.

beats.headline: She explains how the shows work
beats.text: Carl meets his first Borant Dungeon Admin and manages to be civil. Zev walks them through crawler participation on Syndicate programmes. She, Donut and Mordecai then bond over Gossip Girl.

beats.headline: Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem
beats.text: The Maestro bullies Li Jun and Zhang on air. Carl gambles on being too valuable to punish and gets them, their boss, and Li Jun's sister Li Na out of the Brindled Vespas.

beats.headline: Under a million
beats.text: A recap, a wipe of Le Mouvement, and the remaining-crawler count drops below seven figures. Carl hears that number the way other people hear a tap dripping.

beats.headline: Wiped
beats.text: Another recap carries the news, and the remaining-crawler count drops below a million in the same broadcast.

beats.headline: Seven inches of pink feathers, in a cage
beats.text: A level-1 pet-class mob locked in a secret reward room, newly hatched and looking mostly like an angry chicken. He attacks both of them the moment the cage opens. Donut wins him over by turning him loose on Brindle Grubs and showing him how to open their bellies for the good part.

beats.headline: She adopts a dinosaur
beats.text: A reward room on the second floor holds a caged pet-class mob. She takes him, names him hers, and treats him as her child from that hour on.

beats.headline: Taken with the Cat race
beats.text: Her constitution rules out melee, so she fights on charisma and spells. The per-level pick is why a show cat out-scales most of the humans, and Mordecai points out she keeps the skills from every class she leaves behind.

beats.headline: Manoeuvred into managing a cat
beats.text: Odette rates his memory as the most valuable thing a crawler could get hold of, so Carl and Donut arrange his appointment during class selection, and it has to look like an accident. He would forgive Donut. He would never forgive Carl.

beats.headline: The rules he cannot break
beats.text: Most of what he knows he may not volunteer; some of it he may only give up if asked the exact question. Without press credentials no viewer can see or hear him. As a manager he may not fight mobs directly. His advice is to stay ahead of the curve, never trust an elite, and stay away from gods — none of which survives contact with Carl.

beats.headline: Her advice makes the party
beats.text: Donut's class and Mordecai's appointment both come from her, and Mordecai is not to know he was steered.

beats.headline: Cat, and a Former Child Actor
beats.text: On Odette's advice she takes a class that lets her choose another class at every level, and installs Mordecai as her decidedly unwilling manager. Her constitution is far too low for melee, so she fights on charisma, spells and audience.

beats.headline: Primal, and a Compensated Anarchist
beats.text: Class selection, on the way into the Over City. He takes the Primal race and a monk/rogue hybrid nobody has picked before. The system's own assessment: "a trapmaking, bomb-making, social-media dynamo" who "will happily throw a Molotov through a window one moment and step in front of a camera to plead for the violence to stop the next." It has not needed revising since.

beats.headline: Taken with the Primal race
beats.text: "Will happily throw a Molotov through a window one moment and step in front of a camera to plead for the violence to stop the next."

beats.headline: He stands over her
beats.text: A trap paralyses Donut in the Over City. He plants himself across her body and nearly dies holding off a swarm of spiky Street Urchins. He rarely listens to Carl. His loyalty to her is not negotiable.

beats.headline: The circus in the Over City
beats.text: His company is pitched in one of the city's districts when Carl and Donut scout it.

beats.headline: Met outside Grimaldi's circus
beats.text: Carl and Donut scout Grimaldi's Traveling Circus as night falls and the mobs form up, and escape under magical mortar fire. She is on the other side of it. Her charisma runs past a hundred and projects an allure Carl can only break by snapping his own finger.

beats.headline: Carl signs on to her show
beats.text: He agrees to appear in Vengeance of the Daughter, which films on the sixth floor. He reads the Wisp Armor Spell book first, for protection against mind control.

beats.headline: First time on the recap
beats.text: He features alongside Miriam, Pony and Bianca. In the same broadcast GumGum tries to hand out a Sex Workers Who Fell from the Heavens Quest, and Mordecai tells her where to put it — "You can't save them all."

beats.headline: They carry her as far as they can
beats.text: A neighbourhood boss and a borough boss with Katia and Eva in tow, until class selection splits everyone up and the levels stop adding up.

beats.headline: She goes on without her
beats.text: They entered together. Class selection separated them, and she kept moving.

beats.headline: She asks them to take her
beats.text: The Daughters carried Katia and Eva through a neighbourhood boss and a borough boss. When the levels stop adding up, Hekla is the one who asks.

beats.headline: Ten levels behind and nobody's problem
beats.text: She came in with her friend Eva and fell in with Hekla's Brynhild's Daughters, who carried the two of them through a neighbourhood boss and a borough boss. Class selection split them up, Eva did not wait, and by the time Hekla asks the Royal Court to take her the system has only just upgraded her displayed race from "What the f-word?" to "Human."

beats.headline: Doppelgänger, Monster Truck Driver
beats.text: Her guide Bannon talks her into a momentum-based constitution tank who can reshape her own mass — body and equipped gear together — into any form of equal weight. She sculpts her face using the reflection off a health potion bottle, and it shows. Carl charitably compares the result to a Juan Gris painting.

beats.headline: She spends a death sentence saving NPCs
beats.text: The Fools Who Broke the Glass Quest triggers not long after she joins, and it is close to unsurvivable. She uses it trying to get NPCs out, and tells Carl and Donut to save themselves.

beats.headline: Out for their blood
beats.text: The recap has her hunting Carl and Donut specifically.

beats.headline: Built in the middle of a collapse
beats.text: During the Fools Who Broke the Glass, Carl drops a Sheol Glass Reaper Case around a Soul Crystal that is already going up and pulls the result into his inventory. Rated Pretty Damn Rare. Status: Explosion Imminent. "This item can no longer be stabilized."

beats.headline: Forty-five kilometres
beats.text: Enough to take a city and every suburb around it. He cannot drop it, sell it or make it safe, and it detonates the millisecond it is out of his hands. "Created by a man who murders babies and steals rare collectibles from his elders."

beats.headline: Destroying it does not help
beats.text: The crown is blown apart in the Over City's collapse. The succession survives it.

beats.headline: Destroyed, and it changes nothing
beats.text: The third blast of the Over City's collapse takes the crown apart. The succession is untouched. It said as much on the label.

beats.headline: It burns a veto rather than pay
beats.text: Eighty-three Celestial boxes are owed. Borant voids them with its one seasonal veto and still ends up in court over the one that was already open. A production company that cheap has seams worth looking for.

beats.headline: Eighty-three Celestials, and one veto
beats.text: A quest reward gets double-upgraded to Celestial for 83 crawlers. Borant burns its single seasonal veto to void them and is a moment too slow — Quan Ch has already opened his, which leaves the company liable and in a Syndicate court. The upgrade achievements responsible are patched out immediately.

beats.headline: He opens his before the veto lands
beats.text: Eighty-three crawlers are owed Celestial boxes. Borant spends its one seasonal veto to void them and is a fraction too slow: his is already open, which leaves the company liable and in front of a Syndicate court.

beats.headline: The cliff at the fourth floor
beats.text: The early floors are built to bury crawlers in low-tier loot and beginner skills. From here boxes and achievements get very much harder to come by.

beats.headline: A Scree riding Chris Andrews
beats.text: Maggie comes back inside another crawler. Frank dies of it. Carl cuts her out, she goes for him, and Mongo finishes her.

beats.headline: He finishes Maggie My
beats.text: When the Scree parasite comes off Chris Andrews and goes for Carl, Mongo kills it.

beats.headline: A level-5 space, from an odd little box
beats.text: Carl, Donut and Katia each get a special achievement whose box holds personal space coupons — beds, a shower, a crafting studio and a training room. Donut installs a cat tree.

beats.headline: On the recap
beats.text: He shows up on the between-floors broadcast with Elle, Team Li Na, Ifechi, Florin, Miriam, Hekla and Lucia.

beats.headline: The board, two hours in
beats.text: Elle, Team Li Na, Ifechi, Florin, Miriam, Prepotente, Hekla and Lucia, all in one broadcast. It is how the crawl keeps track of itself.

beats.headline: Hired at the bar
beats.text: Carl and Donut take him and The Sledge on at the Desperado, meet Elle and Imani there, and Donut orders a dirty Shirley in a bowl with extra cherries.

beats.headline: The twenty-fifth holder of the Cookbook
beats.text: Twenty-four crawlers carried it before him, across seasons and species and worlds that no longer exist. Whatever he does from here, he is finishing somebody else's work.

beats.headline: The Tangle cannot be beaten alone
beats.text: Hundreds of crawlers have to move at once for the trains to come apart, and coordination on that scale is the one thing production spends its budget preventing. He stops thinking of explosives as the weapon.

beats.headline: Hiring, and a dirty Shirley
beats.text: They take on Bomo and the Sledge there and meet Elle and Imani. It stops being a bar the moment it becomes a labour market.

beats.headline: Introduced in the Iron Tangle
beats.text: It arrives with the sponsor tab unlocking. Twenty-four crawlers carried it first, across seasons and species, on worlds that lost. Rosetta Thagra, later found hosting Shadow Boxer, is one of the authors.

beats.headline: Same plan, other side of the Tangle
beats.text: Carl's group means to blow every ghoul generator and finds her and Prepotente already attempting it from the far side.

beats.headline: The desert quadrant
beats.text: Carl's team goes looking for other crawlers and finds him with Firas, and Langley's team of car-salesman archers. They fight a Thorny Devil and a Gnomish Drop Bear on the way to the Bactrian town, and fall back.

beats.headline: Debuff stacking, ruined
beats.text: Highlights from the previous floor show him and Miriam Dom stacking debuffs on a boss with real precision, and Quan Ch wrecking the plan.

beats.headline: He wrecks the debuff stack
beats.text: The recap shows Miriam Dom and Prepotente working a boss down with stacked debuffs, and Quan Ch ruining it.

beats.headline: Louis brings her
beats.text: The other crawlers in the quadrant find Carl's group, and Louis has her with him. Mordecai gives Louis and Firas a rapid detox.

beats.headline: Hidden in the tomb
beats.text: Carl learns of it from the description of Ruckus, out in the desert quadrant. It lies buried in the Necropolis of Anser, and it has drawn treasure hunters for decades: the bugbear submarine captain Shamus Chaindrive, who spent close to twenty years looking for the tomb, a colony of dirigible gnomes, and the Mad Dune Mage. An artifact of this grade has no business appearing before the eighth or ninth floor, and the AI times out repeatedly reconciling the conflict.

beats.headline: Three pieces, three holders
beats.text: A winding box and two magically linked pocket watches. Henrik the Changeling has one watch, the gnomish Commandant Kane the other, and Ghazi the box. The quest to collect all three offers a reward of "Oh boy-oh-boy."

beats.headline: How to work it
beats.text: Dial a time standing for coordinates on one watch and the other mirrors it. Both go in the box, which winds and must not move more than about five feet or the count resets. Pulling the watches out opens a one-way portal twenty feet high, good for roughly twenty minutes. Afterwards it stays where it was opened as a two-way passage into the Nothing until something comes out — usually a feral god, mad from however long it has been down there. A weak constitution too near an open portal gets painted with the same madness.

beats.headline: The bubbles are inhabited
beats.text: The pocket worlds hold whole civilisations — the Necropolis of Anser, the pazuzu town of Pandinus, a colony of dirigible gnomes — living there before any crawler arrived.

beats.headline: She kills Ghazi and takes his notes
beats.text: The sand ooze boss dies and the walls start coming in. She gets out with Ghazi, then kills him for the notes explaining how the Gate works. Carl and Donut are still buried when she does it.

beats.headline: He opens the valve
beats.text: With Gwen he opens a valve and floods the place while Carl and Donut are trapped under the sand.

beats.headline: A reverse compass
beats.text: The linked watches fix an exact position relative to anywhere else once altitude is accounted for. Katia works out it could open onto Larracos on the ninth floor — and Mordecai points out that crawlers cannot use it to skip floors, so all that would accomplish is releasing whatever comes out when it shuts.

beats.headline: She turns the watches into a map
beats.text: The linked watches read as a reverse compass — a time, an altitude, and an exact position relative to anywhere else. She uses them to work out that the Gate could open onto the city of Larracos on the ninth floor, and starts mapping ground nobody has stood on.

beats.headline: The head from Ghazi's castle
beats.text: The Lika doll head Carl took out of Ghazi's castle un-crystallises into a withering spirit. She is half the soul of Psamathe, left like this by her own attempt to get out of the Nothing. They hire her.

beats.headline: What escaping it costs
beats.text: Psamathe tried to get out and ended up as half a soul in a doll's head. Every closing Gate portal lets one of the inmates through on the opening side. The winding box alone is a direct conduit — wound and fed a stream of charged energy it will drop an entire location, up to a whole necropolis, into the void.

beats.headline: Out of Lusca, and an ocean with it
beats.text: Carl, Katia and Tran kill Lusca and her babies at the bottom of the water quadrant. Carl opens the Gate and takes the three of them to the surface outside the pazuzu town of Pandinus. A wall of ocean comes through behind them and nearly flattens the place. A feral god is loose, and the true pantheon is furious enough to send deities rampaging across the popped bubbles.

beats.headline: One of the three who go through the Gate
beats.text: He, Carl and Katia kill Lusca and her babies. Then Carl opens the Gate and takes the three of them out of the water quadrant, and a feral god comes through behind them.

beats.headline: Seven factions sue, and lose
beats.text: Holding it is enough to make him a target. Seven of the nine faction-wars factions go to Syndicate court to strip the pieces from him and are thrown out for lack of standing. Carl collects seven Fight the Power achievements, with stock certificates and photographs of the plaintiffs' mothers. A late challenge from the Skull Empire fails too.

beats.headline: Seven factions lose in court
beats.text: They sue to strip the Gate of the Feral Gods from Carl and are dismissed for lack of standing. He collects seven Fight the Power achievements, stock certificates, and photographs of the plaintiffs' mothers.

beats.headline: A quest to bring Orthrus home
beats.text: Carl and Donut fly a plane and use Meat Hooks to lead Orthrus clear, with a quest to bring the creature to Emberus — and a conflicting quest offered against it.

beats.headline: He worships a god to survive a plane crash
beats.text: Falling out of the sky with Quan Ch about to finish him, he takes Emberus as his patron and throws a celestial grenade. The god arrives at his position, and he is briefly impossible to kill. Emberus and Orthrus find each other and are gone.

beats.headline: Summoned by a celestial grenade
beats.text: With the plane coming down and Quan Ch about to finish him, Carl takes Emberus as patron and throws the grenade. The god arrives where Carl is and makes him briefly unkillable. Emberus and Orthrus find each other and go.

beats.headline: The plane, and the grenade
beats.text: He has Carl beaten in a crashing aircraft when Carl worships Emberus and throws the celestial grenade.

beats.headline: Waiting on the last stage
beats.text: She is with Carl and Donut when they hold for the final part of the plan, while Katia goes for the water quadrant.

beats.headline: Her mother comes when called
beats.text: The feral demon Slit comes hunting her, so they let her out of the safe room to fight it. What answers is her mother, who kills Slit.

beats.headline: Agent Provocateur
beats.text: The bomb-focused specialisation, taken as the Hunting Grounds open. Zockau burns. He marks hunters with the Ring of Divine Suffering, kills them, and takes their stats, and enough of them die inside the Desperado Club that the survivors have to be dug out.

beats.headline: Agent Provocateur
beats.text: The bomb-focused specialisation, taken on the Hunting Grounds.

beats.headline: He named her Tsarina
beats.text: He pulled her out of the hands of the High Elves when she was a child and raised her in the circus. She grew up and fell in love with him. When she told him she would have been a tsarina had she been full-blooded Naiad, he made it her name.

beats.headline: The Daughters come apart
beats.text: What she decided earlier catches up with her, Katia and Eva on the Hunting Grounds.

beats.headline: Signet has a writers' room
beats.text: Vengeance of the Daughter is a scripted programme with producers steering her grief and her revenge for the audience. She is not something the dungeon generated. She is someone it is being done to.

beats.headline: Tish's note
beats.text: According to a note left by his associate Tish, the Gate of the Feral Gods was considered essential to defeating Scolopendra, whose poison has already done its work on the Hunting Grounds.

beats.headline: Daughter of King Finian, and of nobody
beats.text: Her father rules the High Elves of the Liana Sector. Her mother was a Naiad princess, murdered, after which the Confederacy took the Naiad crown and Signet was exiled by both halves of her family. Grimaldi's circus took her in as a child. The programme built around all of this is watched across the galaxy.

beats.headline: Blood magic, cast on a loser
beats.text: She raises Blood and Ink Elementals out of the tattoos moving under her skin. To make one she sets two creatures against each other and casts on whichever she judges will lose, before it takes a single injury — and she may not bleed the sacrifice herself. Only a killing blow releases what she needs. One summoning a night.

beats.headline: Her loyalty does not extend to crawlers
beats.text: She tries to use Carl as an involuntary blood sacrifice, puts Donut under the Water Lily Spell, and forces Carl to help her reach the cursed circus. Everything she has goes to the family that took her in.

beats.headline: Part of the price of the Gate
beats.text: Quasar bargains Carl's temporary surrender of the Gate for four free mercenaries — Bomo, the Sledge, Clay-ton and Very Sullen — plus two spells given to Bomo and the Sledge that reproduce two of the Gate's abilities.

beats.headline: The deal for the Gate
beats.text: She arrives and negotiates: the Gate goes back temporarily, and in return four mercenaries come free and two spells reproducing the Gate's abilities go to Bomo and the Sledge.

beats.headline: He moves them to the stairwell
beats.text: With the hunters about to be released, he teleports Carl and Donut to the stairwell in Zockau.

beats.headline: Full of hunters when the roof comes in
beats.text: Carl's explosives bring Zockau down and trap a great many of them inside it.

beats.headline: Zockau
beats.text: Carl goes at the hunters with it — marking them, killing them, taking the stats — while his explosives bring the town down around them and trap a great many inside the Desperado Club. He is badly hurt getting out.

beats.headline: A vampire now
beats.text: The Hunting Grounds change what she is. In the same stretch Mordecai warns Carl off the Ring of Divine Suffering, on the grounds that it is addictive.

beats.headline: Mordecai's warning
beats.text: He tells Carl to leave it alone. It is addictive.

beats.headline: She reminds him the contract stands
beats.text: On the Hunting Grounds she points out that his agreement with Vengeance of the Daughter is still in effect. Nothing signed on an earlier floor stops mattering.

beats.headline: She wants her body back
beats.text: She screams to be taken to Signet, who she insists can restore her. Carl agrees to bring her if she will be quiet.

beats.headline: Familiar to Queen Imogen
beats.text: The party runs into the High Elves, and the queen's familiar is Ferdinand. He attacks Mongo. Donut takes the blast in front of him and lives only because of her cockroach ability.

beats.headline: He writes his own plan into it
beats.text: Alongside pages from the secret bathroom notepad the team has been using to talk without being heard. Primary goal: survive the Butcher's Masquerade. Secondary goals attached.

beats.headline: What is inside Lucia
beats.text: He comforts her, and tells the others there are multiple presences in her head, other children among them, and that the dog is central to whatever is happening.

beats.headline: More than one of her in there
beats.text: Florin says there are several presences in her head, other children among them, and that the dog matters.

beats.headline: More than one voice in there
beats.text: Florin says there are several presences in her head, other children among them, and that the dog is the key to it.

beats.headline: Katia kills her
beats.text: On the last night of the Hunting Grounds it is settled.

beats.headline: Taken off Imogen
beats.text: Someone named Osvaldo takes hers, and Prepotente goes after him for it.

beats.headline: He shatters the seventh floor
beats.text: The Great Race was rushed in as a Valtay-funded replacement and it was structurally compromised. Minutes after it opened he broke the entire circuit of glass tunnels into fine dust. Not one crawler entered the maze. Not one mob, NPC or boss was ever met on it.

beats.headline: Huanxin, Uzzi, and what happened
beats.text: Odette's price for her help is the old catastrophe, and his part in it.

beats.headline: Her price is the truth
beats.text: Huanxin Jinx trades help for putting Odette in as adjutant, and Odette's own price is the old catastrophe involving Huanxin, Mordecai and Uzzi.

beats.headline: She fights with people
beats.text: On the card floor her deck includes Alpha Male Carl and Shi Maria, and both of them are somebody. She plays them anyway.

beats.headline: Inside the Engaged Lock Box of the Night Wyrm
beats.text: The system is characteristically unhelpful: "It's a flower. You're supposed to eat it, though it might be a good decoration instead. It probably tastes like a bullshit salad at some hippie vegan restaurant with a month-long waiting list." Eating it means an hour unconscious at 1% health with healing blocked. Survive and Eileithyia grants one of three permanent boons, her choice — unless you worship her first, in which case she expands the descriptions and asks your preference. Her cooperation is not guaranteed.

beats.headline: A new friend who can cast it
beats.text: On the Ghosts of Earth she has found Shi Maria, who she says can work the spell that gives her a body.

beats.headline: Carl sees through the act
beats.text: She has been performing for Samantha's benefit. Carl reads it, and makes a different deal: she lets them turn her into a card, and they get her to the next floor.

beats.headline: She wins the floor
beats.text: Against the Reminiscence Hydra of Malicious Compliance and its totems — Alpha Male Carl and King Croissant — she does most of the work. Carl looks away at the wrong moment.

beats.headline: At the church with the rest
beats.text: By the Ghosts of Earth she reaches the church with her own squad, alongside Katia, Imani and Li Na's people — all of them there on Doggy Door upgrades Lucia handed out before she went down the stairs.

beats.headline: Her squad reaches the church
beats.text: She, Katia, Elle and Imani converge there on Doggy Door upgrades Lucia handed round before descending.

beats.headline: Lucia hands out Doggy Doors
beats.text: Tier 3 upgrades, given round before she went down the stairs, are how Katia, Elle, Imani and Li Na's squads all reach the church on the eighth floor.

beats.headline: He takes command of one of nine armies
beats.text: Thirty days, a castle at Larracos in the middle of the map, and no way to come back from a death. Supply, alliance and atrocity, at a scale where the arithmetic stops being personal.

beats.headline: Due before anyone descends
beats.text: The Sultanate holds the ninth floor, and the stairs to the tenth stay shut until the Sultan and his family are dead.

beats.headline: The Sultanate is on this floor
beats.text: The stairs to the tenth do not open for a royal who has not killed the Sultan and the rest of the family.

beats.headline: Thirty days, nine armies, one castle
beats.text: Roughly 32,000 conscripted crawlers and 50,000 retired ones against something near 100,000 armed enemies, fighting over Larracos at the centre of the map. Nothing that dies here comes back.

beats.headline: The crown comes due
beats.text: The Blood Sultanate holds the ninth floor, and every royal in the line must kill the Sultan and the rest of the family before the stairs to the tenth will open. She is a royal in the line. She has been since the first floor.

beats.headline: Donut wears his cloak
beats.text: She puts it on and takes the benefits, along with the Tiara of a Thousand Lights out of a celestial box from Long Haul Biological Waste Management Solutions.

beats.headline: Long Haul Biological Waste Management Solutions
beats.text: Donut's celestial box from the sponsor holds it. She puts on Quan Ch's cloak in the same stretch and takes the benefits of both.

beats.headline: Larracos: water, charges and sharks
beats.text: The plan had been to open onto the Skull Empire army and put a feral god in the middle of it — the exact outcome the lawsuit was meant to prevent. He changes it at the last moment, keeps the artifact rather than spending it, and floods the faction market instead: ocean water, timed explosives and a frenzy of sharks, cutting the factions off from resupply. Juice Box goes through with the water.

beats.headline: Through the portal with the water
beats.text: When Larracos floods she goes through with it, hides among the survivors, and tells the NPCs what they are.

beats.headline: Juice Box tells them
beats.text: Under cover of the Larracos flood she hides among the survivors and spreads word of what they are.

beats.headline: Inside him, and not staying quiet
beats.text: Stockade tries to pull Carl bodily to his position while Mordecai tries to force Shi Maria out of him. What comes of it is her rampage through the Lemig base, which the adjutant Panford is left to explain.

beats.headline: The rampage through the Lemig base
beats.text: Stockade tries to pull Carl bodily to his position while Mordecai tries to force her out of him. What comes of it is hers, and the adjutant Panford is left explaining the wreckage.

beats.headline: Killed by the Blood Hunter show, and answered for
beats.text: Most of the Naga army turns up dead on the ninth floor. Prepotente killed them, as payment for the programme that killed her.

beats.headline: He kills the Naga army
beats.text: Elle reports most of it already dead. He did it for Miriam Dom.

beats.headline: Akuma's warning
beats.text: Warlord Akuma tells the Warlord Chat that the War Mages are leaving the floor with the Scavenger's Daughter — and warns Carl and Donut that Agatha is an enemy to all of them.

beats.headline: Akuma says it in the Warlord Chat
beats.text: As the War Mages quit the floor with the Scavenger's Daughter, he warns Carl and Donut about her. He does not elaborate.

beats.headline: The War Mages leave with it
beats.text: Akuma tells the Warlord Chat they have found it and are quitting the floor. He uses the same breath to warn Carl and Donut about Agatha.

beats.headline: The show may not survive its own season
beats.text: The power structure that built Dungeon Crawler World begins coming apart around it.

beats.headline: He lets them all out
beats.text: Justice Light releases every one of the gods.

beats.headline: She takes the Orchid and walks out
beats.text: She eats the flower, spends an hour at one percent, and leaves the crawl entirely — human again, and not all there.

beats.headline: One hundred and twenty thousand
beats.text: Her body holds more than 120,000 human children. Nobody has said what for.

beats.headline: The count
beats.text: Her body holds more than 120,000 human children.

beats.headline: Nearly lost, and then a father
beats.text: The ninth floor comes very close to taking him. Ser Rendelgor pulls him out. He walks off that floor a parent.

beats.headline: They organise
beats.text: The floor's NPCs form an independent tenth faction. No season has recorded such a thing, and there is no procedure for it.

beats.headline: Katia's way out
beats.text: She takes it and leaves the crawl, human again and missing pieces of herself.

beats.headline: Unprecedented
beats.text: The ninth floor's NPCs form an independent faction of their own. Nothing in the show's history has a procedure for it, and Juice Box lit it from inside the faction market.

beats.headline: Dead, and the Nothing with him
beats.text: The crawlers reach the tenth floor to find Justice Light dead and the Nothing broken. 5,501 of them are left.

beats.headline: More often, and worse
beats.text: Whatever is running the dungeon is no longer running it cleanly.

beats.headline: Broken
beats.text: The crawlers arrive on the tenth floor to find Justice Light dead and the Nothing broken.

beats.headline: The Garden of Deliverance
beats.text: With the transfer to the Pineapple Cabaret working, her Dread is what watches over every crawler sent across.

beats.headline: She holds the portal open
beats.text: On the tenth floor she re-opens the portal so Louis and the crawlers from the multi-crawler heats can come through, while the rest cross the finish line and take the stairs.

beats.headline: Out through Imani's portal
beats.text: On the racing floor he and the other crawlers from the multi-crawler heats come through the portal Imani holds open.

beats.headline: Every inventory changes hands at once
beats.text: Eris fires the effect and each crawler's inventory swaps with whoever is nearest. Donut ends up holding Carl's, and he immediately asks her to combine a bomb and an enhanced pet biscuit.

beats.headline: A memorial crystal made by his death
beats.text: After the last boss falls, Carl finds one that came from Emberus dying.

beats.headline: Carried down
beats.text: The stairwells to the twelfth floor open, and Lucia takes him down them unconscious.

beats.headline: Two of them, at the end
beats.text: Taranis steals Prepotente's. Carl finds another, made by Emberus dying.

relations.note: The Royal Court, such as it is.
She considers him her son. He agrees.
